name: CodeFormer
plain: CodeFormer (Zhou et al., S-Lab NTU, NeurIPS 2022): restores a degraded face (an aligned 512 x 512 crop) by predicting codes of a learned face codebook; fidelity w trades quality against faithfulness. Non-commercial code and weights (S-Lab License 1.0).
summary: CodeFormer (Zhou et al., NeurIPS 2022): blind face restoration with a learned codebook: a VQGAN encoder, a transformer that predicts the code of each of the 16 x 16 latent positions, and the VQGAN decoder with controllable feature fusion from the encoder (fidelity w). Input: an aligned 512 x 512 face crop (FFHQ alignment); detecting, aligning and pasting the face back are not part of the model.

papers.title: Towards Robust Blind Face Restoration with Codebook Lookup Transformer

no_kernels_reason: not built yet: a VQGAN of 3x3 convolutions with GroupNorm around a 16 x 16 transformer; fp16-accumulate convolutions (`cudnn_hacc`) are the next step
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: the restored (upscaled) image, `model.scale` x the input size, RGB in [0, 1]. `tile=` runs large images in overlapping tiles (as ComfyUI).

variants.name: codeformer

licence.training_note: Paper Sec. 4.1: FFHQ (70 000 faces, resized to 512 x 512) with synthetic degradations (blur, downsampling, noise, JPEG).

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 512, padded to a multiple of 32

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: upstream inference_codeformer.py on the aligned face, float32, w 0.5

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `image`).
